تنتخبوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَخِبُوا (tantaḵibū) /tan.ta.xi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# تُنْتَخَبُوا (tuntaḵabū) /tun.ta.xa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
